headline: Buyer Protection Policy: Homes Without Completed Structure Will Find It Harder to Be Sold in Advance in China
summary: Three Chinese ministries and commissions announced on August 28 that future residential projects must prioritise selling completed homes. The rule aims to avoid construction delays that affect home buyers.
why: China's property sector is a major driver of its economy, and pre-sale financing has been central to how developers fund projects. Rules on presales affect developer cash flow and buyer confidence.
